core_problem_solved: To provide a Java library for advanced console input handling, enabling interactive command-line applications with features like line editing, history, and tab completion, similar to a standard Unix shell.
key_features: Rich console line editing and character-level input
Persistent command history (e.g., using arrow keys)
Support for ANSI colors and styles for formatted output
era_and_niche: The modern, de facto standard library for building interactive command-line interfaces (CLIs) in Java. It is a core component of many popular CLI tools and frameworks, like Spring Shell, Groovy's shell, and others.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete** and is actively maintained. It is the direct successor to older console-reading libraries (including its own previous versions under different coordinates) and has established itself as the leader in its niche.
